content:
The 2026 Best Buy Memorial Day sale has now been updated with new deals, while Amazon’s is still in full swing with additional offers as well – today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by the return of Memorial Day pricing on AirPods Pro 3 at one of the best prices yet. Equally as notable, we also have the base 16GB/512GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air hitting the Amazon all-time low at nearly $200 off, just after the 13-inch models returned to all-time lows at $150 off. The 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 Cell model is back at its best price ever ($130 off) and Amazon’s clearance price on the 13-inch 1TB M3 iPad Air just dropped again to new all-time low at a giant $400 off. Head below for a closer look.

Hello! AirPods Pro 3 drop to one of the best prices yet at $199 for Memorial Day

It’s back folks! Amazon is once again offering one of the best deals ever on AirPods Pro 3 down at $199 shipped ahead of Memorial Day 2026.

Amazon now has Apple’s latest AirPods Pro 3 down at $199 shipped. Regularly $249, this is a straight up 20% off the list price and the best deal around.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods Max 2 $509 (Reg. $549) – Amazon all-time low

We spotted this same deal a few days ago for just under 24 hours before Amazon bumped the price back up. It appeared as though it was dropping the latest pro-grade Apple buds down to a special price for Memorial Day weekend, then decided to get rid of the deal completely, only to bring it back again today. Is it going to remain through the weekend and into Memorial Day proper on Monday? Who knows at this point, but this is the deal we expected to see for the 2026 holiday and it is once again live (for now).

We have tracked AirPods Pro 3 down at $200 a few times over the last couple months since the Amazon Big Spring Sale in late March, but this deal drops them another $1 lower than that to deliver the best deal of the year you might actually get a chance to take advantage of.

There was a very short-lived offer down at $185 for a day or two, but even that was hard to get. It kept going in and out of stock, and was really just Amazon attempting to price match and steal sales away from the Verizon Store that was largely only available to those who managed to make it through checkout online and then go pick them up at a brick and mortar Verizon shop. Some folks did make it happen, but it was a bit of a run around, unlike this straight up cash discount you can lock in right now.

UPDATE: Hello! Apple’s most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air now nearly $200 off (Best price ever)

As part of its now updated Memorial Day sale, Amazon just dropped the most affordable new Apple 13-inch M5 MacBook Air down to a new all-time low at just shy of $200 off – this is the best price we have ever tracked.

Amazon is now offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB storage capacity down at $899.99 shipped.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $900 (Reg. $1,099) – Amazon all-time low
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,149 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,100 (Reg. $1,299) – Amazon all-time low
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,549 (Reg. $1,699)

Base 16GB/512GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air hits Amazon all-time low at nearly $200 off

Yesterday we tracked one of the very best deals on the M5 MacBook Air. It very quickly jumped back up in price but Amazon is now once again offering nearly $200 off the base model 15-inch Air in Midnight and Starlight.

Amazon now has the Midnight 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB storage capacity down at $1,099.99 shipped – as mentioned above, the Starlight is also sitting at this price as well.

There’s a very good chance this deal comes in and out of stock over the weekend and into Memorial Day on Monday, but there’s no telling for sure. You are indeed looking at the best deal Amazon has offered on the new MacBook Air.

The 13-inch base model (as well as several other upgraded configurations) returned to all-time low pricing this morning, just as we expected them to. They are $150 off as of right now, but you can save even more on the 15-incher at the moment.

As of the time of writing, only the base 16GB/512GB model is seeing the bonus $50 in savings here, and we will keep our eye out for the others, but there’s no telling how long this near $200 price drop will remain or if it will make its way to the other configs at this point.

Live again: 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 Cell model back at its best price ever, now $130 off

Update 5/22: The Jet Black 46mm Aluminum GPS + Cell model at $130 off is now live once again – matching Amazon all-time low.

One of the best deals we have tracked on Apple Watch Series 11 to date just came back at Amazon alongside its now live Memorial Day sale. We have seen some of the much more pricey models with deeper discounts, but we are talking about a return all-time low on the 46mm Aluminum GPS + Cell model at $130 off the list price here (also available in Silver and Rose Gold).

Amazon is now once again offering the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell model at $399 shipped.

This is a regular $529 current-generation Apple wearable at $130 off the list price. That’s a straight up 25% price drop and easily one of the best deals we have tracked on the lineup before you jump up into the premium titanium models.

Today’s deal is matching the lowest price we have tracked to date on this configuration – we were tracking this same deal at the top of the month, but it more recently started jumping back up and down in the last week or so.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell $399 (Reg. $499)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell $399 (Reg. $529)

As you can see above, today’s featured deal puts the larger and more expensive 46mm model at the same price as the discounted 42mm (the latter is $100 off).

Amazon clearance price on 13-inch 1TB M3 iPad Air just dropped again to new all-time low at a giant $400 off

Amazon has been quite aggressive with deal pricing on the still perfectly capable M3 iPad Air over the last month or so as it looks to clear out shelf space for the new M4 model. But, much like we saw with the 11-inch 1TB model yesterday, it is has now knocked another $100 off the 13-inch 1TB model to deliver new all-time low pricing at a giant $400 off.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s 1TB 13-inch M3 iPad Air Wi-Fi + Cell model down at $1,049 shipped. This deal is live on the Gray model only and stock is low – get in there while the gettin’s good.

This config fetched $1,449 before being replaced by the most comparable M4 model at the same price back in March of 2026. Today’s deal lands at $100 less than the previous clearance price we had been tracking to deliver $400 in savings and the lowest we have ever tracked at Amazon.

I might even argue that these clearance M3 iPad Air deals at Amazon are the best iPad discounts we have seen all year. No, they don’t carry the more powerful M4 chip, but at prices like these I would suggest there are more than a few folks out there that really don’t need the new model, and perhaps even more that might not even be able to tell the difference:

  • 11-inch M3 iPad Air Wi-Fi + Cell 512GB $749 (Reg. $1,049) – new Amazon all-time low
  • 13-inch M3 iPad Air Wi-Fi + Cell 1TB $1,049 (Reg. $1,449) – new Amazon all-time low

This upgraded 32GB M5 MacBook Pro is $300 off at Amazon (All-time low)

While we are still tracking Amazon all-time low pricing on the most affordable 16GB/1TB model at $200 off, it is also offering one of the best and deepest deals we have tracked on the M5 lineup overall – the 32GB configuration at $300 off the list.

Amazon is currently offering the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 32GB of RAM and the 1TB storage capacity at $1,799 shipped – this is the lowest price we have ever tracked at Amazon on this model.

This configuration carries a $2,099 list price and is now a straight up $300 off. Again, there have been a few chances to score the 16GB and 24GB models at $200 and $250 off, but this is the deepest discount we have tracked on the M5 overall at Amazon.

Some might argue that if you’re going to get up into the 32GB range on the M5 model, it might be time to step down in RAM and go up to the M5 Pro chip. And while that’s not bad advice, or least worth considering, this 32GB model is still $400 less than the list price on the most affordable M5 Pro, and $200 less than its deal price on Amazon right now.
